newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LATE CHAMOT GOAL GIVES 10-MAN LAZIO UEFA CUP EDGE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE CHAMOT GOAL GIVES 10-MAN LAZIO UEFA CUP EDGE.

text.p: Argentine international defender Jose Chamot headed home six minutes from time to give 10-man Lazio a 1-0 away edge over Lens in their UEFA Cup first round first leg on Tuesday.
The Italian side had defender Giuseppe Favalli sent off on the half-hour after two yellow card fouls in less than five minutes, both late tackles on Lens defender Eric Sikora.
Giuseppe Signori sent over a curling left-footed free-kick from the right in the 84th minute and Chamot rose above the Lens defence to head crisply down and past goalkeeper Jean-Claude Nadon.

Winger Tony Vairelles was far less accurate with two glaring chances for Lens earlier in the second half in front of an open goal, first shooting outside the post then failing to head a cross from the left cleanly and watching the ball sail wide.

Lens, who made an impressive start to the French league season with four successive wins before faltering with a defeat and a draw since, put Lazio under intense pressure early on and were unlucky not to go in front.

Czech winger Vladimir Smicer brought a fine diving save out of goalkeeper Luca Marchegiani, then Guinea striker Aboubacar Camara was only just off target with a spectacular scissors kick in the opening eight minutes.
The northern French side's attractive wing play brought them further chances in the second half with Smicer forcing another save from Marchegiani.
Lazio also had their chances on the break, notably two near-misses by midfielder Diego Fuser, who was just wide with a first half shot and had a second half effort saved by goalkeeper Nadon.

Lens - 1-Jean-Claude Nadon; 2-Eric Sikora, 13-Frederic Dehu (15-Jean-Marc Adjovi-Boco 15th), 4-David Regis, 5-Christophe Delmotte; 9-Mickael Debeve, 17-Marc-Vivien Foe, 10-Frederic Meyrieu; 19-Vladimir Smicer, 7-Aboubacar Camara (12-Philippe Brunel), 11-Tony Vairelles.

Lazio - 1-Luca Marchegiani; 2-Paolo Negro, 4-Dario Marcolin, 6-Jose Chamot, 5-Giuseppe Favalli; 14-Diego Fuser, 13-Alessandro Nesta, 7-Roberto Rambaudi, 10-Igor Protti (17-Guerino Gottardi 33rd); 21-Marco Piovanelli (15-Roberto Baronio 82nd), 11-Giuseppe Signori
